document_dispositions.rationale: Independent coverage audit of the complete supplied document against 271 accepted identities found eight distinct objective-linked omissions: two numeric HBM advanced-packaging economics legs, one explicit P/B quantification limitation, one full OP-BPS-P/B target-price scenario range, three dated valuation-snapshot atoms, and one conflict/prepublication disclosure. Repeated financial-table EPS/PER/PBR/EV-EBITDA rows and target-price history were excluded as semantic duplicates. Generic industry, other-company, navigation, and non-objective metadata were not promoted. All historical broker content is SUPERSEDED and no row is treated as issuer actual, current valuation, signed HBM contract, or independently verified outcome.
